summary: Ethiopia's official e-Land cadastral portal was discovered and its public map HTML/current JavaScript were inspected. No anonymous Dessie parcel ID-plus-geometry response, public schema, CRS, or citywide coverage was verified. A third-party Dessie land-department listing is retained only as a custodian lead, not registry evidence; no GeoJSON sample was retained.
queryOutcomes: Separate English and Amharic discovery queries and outcomes are recorded in city-7177-dessie.json under freshResearch.queries.
requestOutcomes: All executed requests, statuses, route inspection, timeout, and non-results are recorded in city-7177-dessie.json under requests.

requestCoordinates.coordinateOrderNote: Exact WUP latitude/longitude preserved; no coordinate shift applied.

safeFieldAllowlist: stable native parcel ID if exposed
geometryQuality: No parcel geometry response obtained; zero samples retained.

geometryDecision.exactWupPointTest: Not completed because no usable anonymous parcel service was identified; this is not evidence of citywide parcel absence.

coverageAssessment.claimedScope: Ethiopia-wide e-Land cadastral/GIS portal and national spatial-data sources.
coverageAssessment.verifiedOpenScope: Portal HTML/JavaScript only; Dessie-local parcel service, schema, CRS, stable identity, geometry, and completeness unverified.

scopeLimits: General national agency prose is not treated as Dessie-local registry evidence.
The directory listing is a local-custodian lead only and does not establish an open map/API.
Zero exact-point hits, unavailable routes, or an unusable UI do not establish citywide absence.
No owner, address, titleholder, contact, tax/account, personal, or other unsafe fields were requested or retained.
Packet completion is research evidence only and does not admit a runtime adapter.
serialReviewerQualification: not qualified; independent serial review remains required
uncertainty: A Dessie or Amhara land office may maintain records outside an indexed anonymous API. The current evidence does not establish public parcel geometry, native identity, CRS, or citywide coverage.
